prediction.confidence_reason: 38 of 49 cash-feasible entries overlap an active book with complete 60-return covariance history, but covariance sizing has mixed historical priors and the >10% EV hurdle is strict.
main_failure_modes: capital released cannot be reused under fixed ordering

predicted_failure_modes: capital released cannot be reused under fixed ordering
calibration.surprise_note: The drawdown thesis worked in every window, but the same shrinkage clipped enough winners that EV and PnL regressed in all three despite eight additional trades.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The raw covariance cross term reduced overlapping book risk as designed, so maximum drawdown improved in all three windows, but it treated profitable common exposure as harmful too. The gate changed final executed shares on 38 entries, with median material scalars of about 0.763 late, 0.619 mid, and 0.598 old; released cash added 8 trades, yet clipped winner contribution exceeded avoided losses and those added trades, leaving every window lower on both EV and PnL.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry this same active-book raw-covariance marginal-variance gate on the canonical outcomes by sweeping lookback length, covariance floors, positive-cross thresholds, scalar caps or floors, active-position subsets, market-residual covariance, or requested-versus-cash-scaled notional variants.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only with an unseen out-of-sample window and an independently predeclared gate, at least +50% and +10 materially new settled forward active-book decisions, or a genuinely new non-price dependence source; otherwise switch evidence surfaces.

production_impact: None. The helper and experiment runner remain default-off research artifacts; quant/run.py, live/default ranking, sizing, orders, and exits were not changed.
